REREAD, structure resolved: the whole tail-Clip block (CRect ctor pair, IntersectRect, the four-dword copy-back, m_gridW/m_gridH) is already instruction-for-instruction identical to retail - only the base register (ours ebx, retail esi reloaded from [esp+0x14]) and the frame-slot offsets differ. Retail has NO board local: it homes this at [esp+0x14] and re-reads m_board from this at THREE sites (the in-loop m_rowInts read, the tail Clip, the hit Clip), and it re-reads unit from its parameter home at [esp+0x7c]. Removing our CMapMgr* board local to match: 73.68 -> 68.65 and it OVERSHOOTS at 416 instructions against retail 411, where keeping it undershoots at 398 - retail hoists m_board into esi for the first straight-line block only, which no whole-function spelling reproduces. Retail also materialises &unit->m_coordList once (leal 0x31c(ecx),eax) and homes it at [esp+0x18], reading the head through it; ours folds every access into a unit-relative displacement because cl keeps unit in a callee-saved register. Same receiver-vs-derived-local asymmetry as 0x0a3820.

Personally rederived after removing inherited @early-stop. Automated INLINE is a repeated-site tail-factoring false positive: base/retail agree on ClaimTilesAround x7, CPtrList ctor x3, FindPathWithEndpointOverrides x3, FindActionByCellKey x1 and every global/recycle referent; only CPtrList dtor is base4/retail3. Retail's list2 tail loads its own ECX receiver then jumps into list3's single dtor call; base emits two calls because list3 alone needs a post-call register reload. Retail/base are 464/468 insns, 72/71 branches, 1/1 ret, 38/39 relocs, frames 0x60/0x68. Retail's extra neighbor-path jmp skips an EDI reload on the already-live arm, and the backedge uses je-exit+jmp-head versus base jne-head+jmp-exit. The complete seven recursive neighbors, eighth tail iteration, void exit, three list searches/count gate, occupancy ladder and recycle loops are present. Remaining derivative strength reduction and tail sharing are allocation/codegen closure, not missing CFG or identity.

Rederived after the whole-object Coord copy recovered retail frame 0x38 and took 82.67 to 84.00; that edit superseded the earlier 268-instruction certification, which had been measured against the field-wise savedX and savedY shape. Base/retail agree on 9 calls, 18 branches, 1 return and 13 ordered relocs. Base is 0x332 bytes and 271 instructions versus retail 0x325 and 268. The residue is the callee-save rotation: retail runs esi/edi/ebx/ebp for unit, this, bottom and right where cl gives esi/ebx/ebp and spills right, and the three extra instructions are that spill with its reload. Earlier campaign tested plain, fieldwise and by-value Coord saves, parameter reuse, saved and edge declaration order, split bottom definition, direct object chain, scoped board capture, just-in-time Coord declarations, a CRect box and an inline Clip boundary, and a 33-state classified sweep found one compiler island at 82.411990. No remaining evidence-backed source lever.

Retail reserves 0x80 against our 0x6c - five dwords we do not declare - and writes BOTH halves of a Coord into the slot pair the fourth GetScreenTile probe later overwrites, which the source models with the cD cross-assignments. NEGATIVE RESULT, measured on a full build: deleting those dead stores (four clean Coords, one probe each) shrinks the frame further to 0x68 and costs 84.88 -> 83.48, and one reused Coord is the same. So the dead stores are load-bearing and the missing five dwords are elsewhere. Do not re-try either spelling.

Two register-choice sites, both the same shape: retail accumulates into the register holding the FIRST-loaded term and we accumulate into the other. (1) the grid lookup m_grid[rec->m_y + rec->m_x*15] - retail mov eax,[eax+4]/add eax,edx, ours mov edi,[eax+4]/add edx,edi. (2) the PlaceObjectFull offsets - retail loads vr->left adjacent to vr->top and does sub eax,edi/add eax,edx, ours loads it late into ecx and reassociates to sub edx,edi/add edx,ecx. Measured flat: an inline helper taking const Coord& (the lever that took HealthUpdate 0x7f180 to EXACT), the same helper taking const Coord*, a Coord copy local (96.60, worse), the x-first index order, the two offset statements swapped, both rect fields bound to locals first, a m_planeCtx local. And the TU is not the cause: a stride-1 typedef sweep over 12 declaration-count states leaves OpenActionOptionsMenu and SpawnGrunt untouched while the unit total does move, so triggermgr is C1-reachable and these two rows are C2-anchored. Register-picker cursor, docs/relevations/cl5-c2-register-picker-is-a-rotating-cursor.md.
